platform_note: H20 is sm_90 (78 SMs). Do not reuse Blackwell tcgen05 conclusions on this target. Supports both homogeneous CTA-level recording (FI_GRAN=1, group="sm_resident") and 2-WarpGroup Warp-Specialized recording (FI_GRAN=0, group="sm", Producer_DMA warps 0..3 cp.async.cg.shared.global + cp.async.mbarrier.arrive.noinc.shared.b64 and Consumer_MMA warps 4..7 mbarrier.try_wait.parity.shared.b64 + MMA + mbarrier.arrive.shared.b64, measured at 57.52 TFLOPS on H20 sm_90a) using branchless predicated PTX fi_record_pred (FI_BG_PRED/FI_EG_PRED) and Rendering Contract R6 pid=1 / upid=1 / sort_index=-1000 topmost [0-100%] hardware utilization.

evidence_summary.scope: Per-semantic statuses describe the availability of target-specific evidence for ISA/recorder guidance; H20 sm_90 is measured for both homogeneous (FI_GRAN=1) and Warp-Specialized (FI_GRAN=0, Producer_DMA/Consumer_MMA, 57.52 TFLOPS) GEMM.

supporting_evidence: Warp-Specialized 2-WarpGroup GEMM (Producer_DMA warps 0..3 / Consumer_MMA warps 4..7, 57.52 TFLOPS on H20 sm_90a)
wgmma.guidance: H20 evidence supports both homogeneous (FI_GRAN=1) and Warp-Specialized (FI_GRAN=0, Producer_DMA/Consumer_MMA) GEMM probes. Always use cp.async.mbarrier.arrive.noinc.shared.b64 in Producer_DMA warps so expected arrival counts are not doubled.

tcgen05.guidance: No sm_90 tcgen05 evidence; treat the family as unavailable unless a new target probe proves otherwise.

recorder.api_family: FI_B / FI_E / FI_M / FI_BG_PRED / FI_EG_PRED / FI_OPEN / FI_CLOSE
recorder.open_close: FI_OPEN installs the lane/wave/CTA recorder predicate; FI_CLOSE is required on every executed exit path and hoists overflow atomicOr out of the K-loop.
fits: ABI tag fields must match the selected recorder. Do not invent a new event layout in the recipe.
notes: Use one logical begin/end pair per selected semantic interval.

Pillar I & II (v14 <= 10% perturbation engine): Inside K-loops, use FI_TIMER=1 dual-anchor affine %clock64 calibration and branchless predicated PTX fi_record_pred via FI_BG_PRED/FI_EG_PRED without ': "memory"' clobber (~166 regs vs 239 regs), electing 1 leader per 128-thread WarpGroup role via FI_OPEN_BY((lin_tid & 127u) == 0u, role) and hoisting overflow atomicOr to fi_close.

Pillar III & IV: Select FI_GRAN=1 (group="sm_resident") for homogeneous GEMM and FI_GRAN=0 (group="sm", roles Producer_DMA=0 / Consumer_MMA=1) for Warp-Specialized GEMM (57.52 TFLOPS on H20 sm_90a), with closed-loop stride selection S in {full(1), stride4(4), stride8(8)} enforcing Measured_Overhead(S*) <= 10.0% (fi_trace_gate.py G1-G5).
Keep aux stable between pair members so waits and phases can be correlated.
The device recorder can only carry a 32-bit aux; move larger descriptors to names.json or the capture metadata.

source_recognition_policy.resolution: Assign a semantic ID only after reading the enclosing dataflow and the operator/task boundary.

correctness_hazards: SASS/ISA disturbance: instrumentation and surrounding code motion can change instruction count, register allocation, spills, vector width, and the selected tensor-core or copy family. Compile FI_LEVEL=0/1/2 and compare the final SASS.
Divergence/mask: a recorder in a divergent branch can produce unpaired records or deadlock a barrier. Preserve the original predicate and use the target wave size for lane selection.
Buffer overflow: fixed slots can fill or point out of range. Require the device overflow bits to be zero, records per lane to stay below cap, and no ring/wrap behavior.
Asynchronous completion: cp.async, TMA, wgmma, and collectives have issue and completion boundaries that are not interchangeable on sm_90.
Correctness drift: moving code across predicates, fences, or waits can change numerical results or visibility even when the kernel still runs.
validation_requirements: Parse all JSON and validate this document against configs/validation/schemas/recipe.schema.json.
Use only semantic IDs present in configs/semantic_ids.json; display names must exactly equal their IDs.
Compile off, entry-only, and full builds with Python 3.10 orchestration where applicable; compare final SASS and register/spill metrics.
Run full-output correctness against an uninstrumented reference with tail, mask, dtype, and shape cases for the selected operator.
Verify cap, slot count, records per lane, overflow bits, and trace completeness.
Capture the selected hardware evidence with nsys and keep H20 sm_90 evidence separate.

semantics.description: Row max, exponentiation, normalization, or another softmax subtask.
source_recognition: row_max / expf or exp2 / row_sum normalization
online-softmax running maximum and denominator rescaling
warp or CTA reduction followed by normalized probability writeback
attention score stabilization before probabilities feed the value product

placement.begin: Immediately before the selected row max, exponentiation, or normalization step for the score tile.
placement.end: After the normalized probabilities are ready for their consumer; use one matching interval per selected softmax subtask.
placement.async_completion_caveat: Softmax itself has no asynchronous completion boundary. If it consumes asynchronously loaded scores, begin only after the matching wait makes those scores visible and account for the wait separately.
placement.scope: phase inside the enclosing attention or operator; one span per selected row max, exponentiation, normalization, or fused softmax region

notes: Use EV_SOFTMAX from the canonical event constants; do not define a local numeric tag.
FI_B/FI_E/FI_M require FI_LEVEL>=2; OPEN/CLOSE require FI_LEVEL>=1.
